en.headline: Hong Kong and Korean police sign MOU to fight cross-border crime
en.dek: The Hong Kong Police Force and the Korean National Police Agency signed a memorandum of understanding in Seoul on 29 July to deepen cooperation on drugs, human trafficking, cybercrime and training.

zh.headline: 港警與韓國警察廳簽署合作備忘錄 打擊跨境罪案
zh.dek: 香港警務處與韓國警察廳7月29日在首爾簽署合作備忘錄，加強打擊跨境罪案及專業培訓合作，涵蓋毒品、人口販運、網絡罪案及情報交流。

en.headline: Former hospital doctor given community service for misappropriating drugs
en.dek: Lee Chi-leung, a former associate consultant at Queen Elizabeth Hospital, was sentenced to 160 hours of community service and ordered to pay HK$20,000 after being found guilty of misconduct in public office.

zh.headline: 前伊院醫生公職人員行為失當 判160小時社會服務令
zh.dek: 前伊利沙伯醫院副顧問醫生李志良因公職人員行為失當，被判160小時社會服務令及向醫管局賠償2萬元，涉及以虛假預約及過量處方方式取得咳藥水及治療專注力不足藥物。

en.headline: Taiwanese man jailed 12 years and four months for cocaine trafficking
en.dek: High Court Judge Wilson Chan sentenced Miao Chi-hung on his final working day after the defendant admitted bringing 890 grams of cocaine into Hong Kong in wine bottles in 2019.

zh.headline: 台灣男子運毒判囚12年4個月 為法官陳嘉信最後一案
zh.dek: 高等法院法官陳嘉信星期四判處台灣男子苗志鴻監禁12年4個月，被告承認2019年以紅酒樽藏有890克可卡因入境，為法官提早退休前最後一次公開聆訊。

en.headline: Two-month LPG fuel subsidy for taxis and minibuses ends tonight
en.dek: The temporary 50-cent-per-litre rebate for liquefied petroleum gas used by taxis, public light buses and school private light buses expires at 11.59 pm, after which drivers will pay full pump prices.

zh.headline: 的士小巴石油氣補貼今晚屆滿
zh.dek: 為期兩個月、每公升0.5元的臨時石油氣燃料補貼將於今晚11時59分結束，受惠車輛其後須按油公司牌價全數付款。

en.headline: Security guard jailed four months for dumping resident's cat in rubbish bin
en.dek: Chau Wing-lok, 62, admitted one count of animal cruelty at Kowloon City Magistrates' Courts after placing a lost cat in a plastic bag and discarding it at Lee Kee Building in Ngau Tau Kok last August.

zh.headline: 牛頭角保安員將走失貓丟入垃圾桶判囚四個月
zh.dek: 62歲周姓保安員承認一項殘酷對待動物罪，於九龍城裁判法院被判即時入獄四個月，案涉去年8月在利基大廈將走失家貓裝袋棄置。

en.headline: Hong Kong and Shenzhen sign colocation arrangement for Huanggang Port
en.dek: Secretary for Security Tang Ping-keung and a Shenzhen vice-mayor signed the co-operation arrangement and right-to-use agreement, bringing the Hong Kong Port Area under HKSAR jurisdiction from midnight.

zh.headline: 港深簽署皇崗口岸「一地兩檢」合作安排
zh.dek: 保安局局長鄧炳強與深圳市副市長今日在中環政府總部簽署合作安排及使用權協議，香港口岸區將於明日零時起由特區依法管轄。

en.headline: HKMA keeps base rate at 4 per cent after Fed holds rates steady
en.dek: The Hong Kong Monetary Authority said the Federal Reserve’s decision to leave the federal funds target range unchanged was in line with market expectations and local markets continued to operate orderly.

zh.headline: 金管局維持基本利率4厘 緊隨聯儲局按兵不動
zh.dek: 金管局表示聯儲局維持聯邦基金利率目標範圍的決定符合市場預期，本港貨幣及金融市場繼續有序運作。

en.headline: Zhongji Innolight shares fall on debut after HK$53.4 billion Hong Kong listing
en.dek: The Chinese optical-parts maker raised HK$53.41 billion in what became Hong Kong’s largest share sale this year; shares opened below the offer price of HK$980.

zh.headline: 中際旭創港股上市集資534億元 首日股價低開
zh.dek: 中國光學零件製造商完成今年本港最大型新股上市，發行價980港元，股份今早低於發行價開出。

en.headline: Customs seizes 36 kg ketamine and 21 kg cannabis at airport, arrests four
en.dek: Two British nationals, a Malaysian man and a local woman were stopped after officers found the drugs in check-in luggage on flights from London and Bangkok; one faces court today.

zh.headline: 海關機場檢獲36公斤氯胺酮及21公斤大麻花 拘四人
zh.dek: 兩名英國籍旅客、一名馬來西亞男子及一名本地女子在倫敦及曼谷航班行李中被發現毒品，其中一人今日提堂。

en.headline: 38 arrested in New Territories South anti-illegal worker operation
en.dek: Police and Immigration Department officers raided multiple locations under Operation CHAMPION on Wednesday; those arrested face offences including illegal entry and breach of stay conditions.

zh.headline: 新界南反非法勞工行動拘38人
zh.dek: 警方聯同入境處星期三在新界南多處進行「冠軍」行動，被捕人士涉嫌非法入境及違反逗留條件等。

en.headline: Box truck overturns on Cheung Ching Road after colliding with van
en.dek: The accident near the Shell oil depot in Tsing Yi blocked multiple lanes and caused heavy congestion on routes towards the airport on Wednesday evening.

zh.headline: 青衣長青公路貨櫃車與客貨車相撞翻側
zh.dek: 星期三傍晚近蜆殼油庫位置發生車禍，多條行車線受阻，往機場方向交通嚴重擠塞。

en.headline: Research Grants Council awards record HK$478 million to 12 university projects
en.dek: More than one-third of the supported proposals under the Areas of Excellence and Theme-based Research schemes involve artificial intelligence applications.

zh.headline: 研資局撥款約4.78億元支持12個大學研究項目
zh.dek: 卓越學科領域計劃及主題研究計劃合共支持破紀錄12個項目，逾三分之一涉及人工智能應用。

en.headline: Police warn of AI voice scams after 150 WhatsApp hijackings cause HK$26 million losses
en.dek: In the past two weeks scammers have used artificial intelligence to imitate the voices of hijacked account holders’ relatives; one victim lost HK$10 million.

zh.headline: 警誡WhatsApp被盜用後AI語音詐騙 兩周150宗損失逾2600萬
zh.dek: 騙徒在過去兩周利用人工智能模仿被盜帳戶親友聲音，其中一宗受害人損失1000萬元。

en.headline: Seven arrested over Tsim Sha Tsui bar assault that left man in critical condition
en.dek: Police say the 32-year-old victim suffered severe head injuries and a fractured rib; some of those arrested are suspected of having triad links and further arrests are not ruled out.

zh.headline: 尖沙咀酒吧傷人案七人被捕 傷者情況危殆
zh.dek: 警方指32歲男傷者頭部嚴重受傷及肋骨骨折，部分被捕人士涉嫌有黑社會背景，不排除再有人被捕。

en.headline: Customs seizes 225,000 electronic chips worth HK$6.25 million at Shenzhen Bay
en.dek: Two men were arrested after officers intercepted an outbound private car and found the suspected unmanifested cargo in the boot; they face court today.

zh.headline: 海關深圳灣檢獲22.5萬枚電子芯片 估值625萬元
zh.dek: 關員截查一輛出境私家車，在車尾箱發現懷疑未列艙單貨物；兩名男子被控意圖輸出未列艙單貨物，今早在屯門裁判法院應訊。

en.headline: Mainland visitor wounded in Mong Kok early-morning attack
en.dek: A 35-year-old man was injured in the neck at a building on Argyle Street around 2 am; police classify the case as wounding and are seeking a suspect.

zh.headline: 旺角凌晨傷人案內地男頸部受傷
zh.dek: 35歲男子約凌晨2時在亞皆老街大廈內頸部受傷，清醒送院；警方列傷人案調查，正通緝一名疑犯。

en.headline: FEHD arrests 14 unlicensed hawkers and seizes nearly 600 kg of food
en.dek: An intelligence-led citywide operation that began on 17 July targeted high-risk locations; suspects aged 38 to 74 face charges including obstruction and selling restricted food.

zh.headline: 食環署拘14名無牌小販檢獲近600公斤食品
zh.dek: 由7月17日起展開的情報主導全港行動針對高風險地點，涉案者年齡38至74歲，大部分另被控阻街，兩人兼控售賣限制售賣食物。

en.headline: CFS finds no excessive lead in over 50 infant formula samples
en.dek: All samples tested between 25 and 28 July, including 11 batches of one brand previously linked to a Macau alert, met Hong Kong’s legal limit of 0.01 mg per kg.

zh.headline: 食安中心抽檢逾50個嬰幼兒奶粉樣本全部鉛含量合格
zh.dek: 7月25至28日抽取的樣本（包括11個曾與澳門通報有關的品牌批次）鉛含量均未超出本港法定上限每公斤0.01毫克。

en.headline: Doctor cleared of misconduct over 2010 laser eye surgeries after 15 years
en.dek: The Medical Council offered no evidence against ophthalmologist Yiu Man-kit on three disciplinary charges linked to Lasik procedures and follow-up treatment.

zh.headline: 眼科醫生涉2010年激光手術專業失德指控不成立
zh.dek: 醫務委員會秘書未有就三項紀律指控提證，眼科醫生姚文傑在事隔15年後獲裁定專業失德不成立。

en.headline: Ex-Cathay Pacific officer jailed 20 months for bribes in human smuggling case
en.dek: Tsui Ying-kit, 45, pleaded guilty to accepting at least HK$18,000 to help ineligible travellers check in at the airport between 2008 and 2009 after years on the run.

zh.headline: 前國泰地勤涉收賄助偷渡判囚20個月
zh.dek: 45歲徐英傑承認於2008至2009年收取至少1.8萬元利益，協助不合資格旅客辦理登機手續，潛逃多年後自首。

en.headline: Coach charged over alleged slap and outdoor punishment of boy at Cheung Chau camp
en.dek: A 51-year-old woman faces two counts of assault and ill-treatment of a child under her care stemming from a 2024 training camp incident; she was granted bail.

zh.headline: 女教練涉長洲營地掌摑及罰企8歲男童被控兩虐兒罪
zh.dek: 51歲教練趙軼群被控於2024年在長洲明愛明暉營襲擊及虐待所看管男童，今在東區裁判法院提堂，獲准保釋至9月再訊。

en.headline: Private residential price index rises 0.3 per cent in June
en.dek: The Rating and Valuation Department reported the index at 323.2, up 12.7 per cent year on year and nearly 8 per cent for the first half.

zh.headline: 6月私人住宅售價指數按月升0.3% 上半年累升近8%
zh.dek: 差餉物業估價署公布6月私人住宅售價指數報323.2，按年升12.7%，上半年累計升近7.9%。

en.headline: Fire at Tin Shui Wai Kingswood Villas flat forces 220 to evacuate
en.dek: A low-floor unit at Le Hu Ju in Kingswood Villas caught fire on Tuesday evening; firefighters put out the blaze with no injuries reported.

zh.headline: 天水圍嘉湖山莊樂湖居單位起火 220居民疏散
zh.dek: 星期二晚天水圍嘉湖山莊樂湖居7座低層單位起火，消防約24分鐘救熄，約220名居民疏散，無人受傷。

en.headline: Man dies after fire engulfs tin-roofed house in Fanling village
en.dek: A blaze at a metal structure in Ling Shan Tsuen early on Wednesday left one man dead and forced about 78 residents to evacuate, police and fire services said.

zh.headline: 粉嶺靈山村鐵皮屋火警 中年男子倒斃現場
zh.dek: 消防凌晨在粉嶺靈山村撲滅鐵皮屋火警，發現一名約50至60歲男子當場不治，約78名居民及寵物疏散。

en.headline: Two arrested for providing illegal tour guide and photography services
en.dek: The Immigration Department and Travel Industry Authority conducted a two-day operation targeting mainland visitors who offered the services via social media.

zh.headline: 入境處聯同旅監局拘兩人涉非法提供導遊及攝影服務
zh.dek: 兩名年齡22歲及31歲女子以旅客身份在社交平台招攬生意，於放蛇行動中被捕，入境處考慮檢控。

en.headline: CFS finds excessive bacteria in Shanghai zhajiang noodles from Kwai Chung shop
en.dek: A sample from a licensed snack food premises contained 95,000 Clostridium perfringens per gram, 8.5 times the limit; the shop was ordered to stop sale and dispose of the product.

zh.headline: 葵涌食肆上海炸醬麵樣本含過量產氣莢膜梭狀芽孢桿菌
zh.dek: 食安中心檢測發現每克含9.5萬個致病菌，超標8.5倍，食肆已按指示停售及棄置有關食品。

en.headline: Water supply suspended overnight in Tuen Mun estates after main leak
en.dek: The Water Supplies Department arranged a temporary suspension from 11pm on Tuesday for repairs after a 600mm fresh water main leaked at a construction site near Fu Fat Lane, affecting about 7,000 residents.

zh.headline: 屯門富發里水管滲漏 多個屋苑昨晚11時起停水維修
zh.dek: 水務署安排星期二晚上11時起暫停食水供應進行搶修，受影響包括怡峰園、顯發邨等約7,000人，爭取星期三中午前恢復。

en.headline: Hong Kong men's foil team takes silver at Fencing World Championships
en.dek: The team of Ryan Choi, Cheung Ka-long, Harris Ho and Leung Chin-yu secured Hong Kong's first-ever team silver medal after a narrow final loss to Italy.

zh.headline: 港隊男子花劍團體賽奪世錦賽銀牌 史上首面
zh.dek: 由蔡俊彥、張家朗、何瑋棋及梁千又組成的港隊在決賽不敵意大利，奪得香港在世錦賽花劍團體項目首面銀牌。

en.headline: Tutorial centre owner jailed for six years and four months over assaults on five boys
en.dek: The High Court sentenced Yu Hey-tsit after he admitted 15 counts of indecent assault and four counts of making child pornography committed at a Mei Foo centre between 2017 and 2023.

zh.headline: 美孚補習社負責人非禮五男童判囚六年四個月
zh.dek: 高等法院星期二判處余希哲監禁六年四個月，被告早前承認15項非禮及4項製作兒童色情物品罪，案涉五名年齡介乎7至14歲男童。

en.headline: Customs seizes 216 live turtles and two eggs at Shenzhen Bay
en.dek: A 52-year-old local driver was arrested after officers found the animals in the boot of an outgoing private car; the haul is valued at about HK$21,800.

zh.headline: 海關深圳灣檢獲216隻活龜及兩枚龜蛋
zh.dek: 一名52歲本地男司機被截查後在私家車尾箱發現動物，估計市值約2.18萬元，男子已獲准保釋候查。

en.headline: Exchange Fund records HK$134.7 billion investment income in first half
en.dek: The Hong Kong Monetary Authority said total assets rose to HK$4,463.6 billion while the fund posted gains on bonds and other equities despite a loss on local stocks.

zh.headline: 外匯基金上半年錄得1347億元投資收入
zh.dek: 金管局公布，外匯基金總資產增至4.46萬億元，債券及其他股票錄得收益，但香港股票投資出現虧損。

en.headline: Wild boar population halves after capture-and-kill policy expanded
en.dek: A Legislative Council research brief showed authorities humanely dispatched 723 wild boars last year, up from 64 in 2021, while the estimated population fell from around 2,000 to 990.

zh.headline: 野豬數量減半 當局去年人道處理逾700頭
zh.dek: 立法會研究報告顯示，漁護署去年人道處理723頭野豬，較2021年的64頭大幅增加，估計數目由約2,000頭降至990頭。

en.headline: New family medicine clinic in Siu Sai Wan to open on 1 August
en.dek: The Hospital Authority said the clinic at Siu Sai Wan Health Centre will provide doctor consultations, preventive screening, chronic disease management and vaccination services for Eastern District residents.

zh.headline: 小西灣家庭醫學診所8月1日起投入服務
zh.dek: 醫管局表示，位於小西灣康健綜合大樓的新診所將提供醫生診症、預防篩查、慢性疾病管理及疫苗接種等服務，加強東區基層醫療。

en.headline: Chief Executive says LegCo by-election lower priority than three major polls
en.dek: John Lee indicated that filling the seat vacated by former lawmaker William Wong Kam-fai ranks behind the Election Committee, chief executive and District Council elections scheduled over the next 18 months.

zh.headline: 李家超指立法會補選優先次序低於三場重要選舉
zh.dek: 行政長官表示，填補前議員黃錦輝出缺議席的補選，在時間及工作量上優先於未來18個月的選委會、行政長官及區議會選舉。

en.headline: Former Democratic Party chairman Wu Chi-wai granted six-month UK stay
en.dek: British immigration authorities approved visitor status for the former legislator after an initial seven-day restriction following his arrival to visit family.

zh.headline: 前民主黨主席胡志偉獲准以旅客身份留英六個月
zh.dek: 英國入境當局在重新審視後批准胡志偉以旅客身份逗留六個月，較早前的七天限制獲解除。

en.headline: Aircraft worker dies after falling from platform at Hong Kong airport
en.dek: A 62-year-old maintenance worker fell about six metres while repairing an aircraft fuselage at a HAECO hangar; the Labour Department has launched an investigation and issued a suspension notice.

zh.headline: 赤鱲角飛機維修工墮下不治 勞工處展開調查
zh.dek: 一名62歲維修工人在港機工程機庫維修飛機外殼時由約6米高工作台墮下，勞工處已展開調查並發出停工通知。

en.headline: Chief Executive holds first dialogue exchange with LegCo members
en.dek: John Lee shared experience on the practice of patriots administering Hong Kong during a closed-door session designed to deepen mutual understanding between the executive and legislature.

zh.headline: 李家超與立法會議員舉行首次對談交流會
zh.dek: 行政長官李家超於閉門會議中分享「愛國者治港」實踐體會，會議旨在增進行政立法互相了解及共識。

en.headline: Amber rainstorm warning issued as heavy rain hits New Territories
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory raised the amber rainstorm signal on Tuesday morning, with waterlogged roads reported in Tai Po and Sha Tin.

zh.headline: 天文台發出黃色暴雨警告 新界多處道路水浸
zh.dek: 天文台星期二早上發出黃色暴雨警告信號，大埔及沙田有道路水浸，兩輛小巴一度受阻。

en.headline: Police investigate suspected arson at Chuk Yuen South Estate
en.dek: A curtain hanging on a flat door in Fu Yuen House caught fire; the case has been classified as arson with no injuries reported.

zh.headline: 竹園南邨單位大門布簾起火 警方列作縱火調查
zh.dek: 黃大仙竹園南邨富園樓一個單位大門上的布簾起火，消防初步懷疑有可疑，警方列作縱火案跟進，無人受傷。

en.headline: Two foreign men arrested in Mong Kok drug syndicate raids
en.dek: Police seized about 7.89 kg of suspected ice and 1.81 kg of suspected heroin worth HK$4.8 million in operations targeting a Kowloon drug syndicate.

zh.headline: 旺角掃毒拘兩名外籍男子 檢值480萬元毒品
zh.dek: 警方在旺角兩個唐樓單位檢獲約7.89公斤懷疑冰毒及1.81公斤懷疑海洛英，估計市值約480萬元。

en.headline: High Court judge Wilson Chan to retire early after repeated plagiarism
en.dek: Chief Justice Andrew Cheung formally requested the early retirement, saying repeated judicial copying had undermined public confidence in the judge’s ability to discharge his duties.

zh.headline: 高等法院法官陳嘉信因多次抄襲提早退休
zh.dek: 終審法院首席法官張舉能正式要求陳嘉信提早退休，指其多次在判詞中抄襲已損害公眾對他履行職務能力的信心。

en.headline: FEHD issues orders after rats spotted inside Hung Hom ParknShop
en.dek: A social media video showed rodents feeding on produce and snacks inside the closed supermarket; the department found signs of rodent activity and required corrective action.

zh.headline: 紅磡百佳發現老鼠 食環署發出法定通知
zh.dek: 社交媒體影片顯示老鼠在已關閉的超市內覓食蔬菜及零食，食環署巡查後發現鼠患跡象並要求限期糾正。

en.headline: Ten injured after minibus collides with water tanker in Kwun Tong
en.dek: Police said the accident occurred near Yue Man Square Public Transport Terminal shortly after midday on Monday; three of the injured were classified as serious but non-life-threatening.

zh.headline: 觀塘小巴與運水車相撞十人受傷
zh.dek: 警方表示，事故於星期一中午過後在裕民坊公共運輸交匯處附近發生，其中三人傷勢被列為嚴重但無生命危險。
